limitations: Measured Linux x64 binaries only; no production FFI external-buffer capability.
GC/finalizer observations are measurements, not scheduling guarantees.
Lifecycle counts are not a malloc byte ledger; finite RSS/heap samples do not prove all possible workloads leak-free.
The external prototype retains a bounded static tombstone table and pins its callback library until process exit.
Benchmarks ran on a shared 8-CPU host and do not establish a portable performance gain.
